native_probes.connectivity: native water-region patch projection against an independent tile flood fill before and after disconnection
native_probes.constructed: profitable ship service whose route traverses both a native lock and aqueduct
native_probes.construction: canal, river, sea, dock join, depot, buoy, lock and aqueduct test/execute/remove legality and state
native_probes.lifecycle: ship build, refit, clone, orders, timetable, service interval, autoreplace, native save/load and sale
native_probes.natural: profitable passenger/freight ship service over a controlled natural sea/river route
native_probes.recovery: unreachable-route detection, explicit stopped recovery, reconnection and bounded profitable completion
native_probes.transfer: native road-to-ship transfer with feeder credit, one final payment and cargo conservation

observation_extension.m17_compatibility: append-only typed extension; M15 tensor/candidate bytes and M16/M17 tables remain unchanged

semantics.competence: natural and constructed passenger/freight service must produce positive final delivery and company income on two deterministic seeds each
semantics.exact_replay: every native case runs in two fresh processes with normalized byte-identical reports
semantics.loading_fixture: bounded source packets and otherwise unavailable sink acceptance may be fixture setup; vehicle movement, transfer, delivery and payment remain native
semantics.recovery: a disconnected route must become observably unreachable, remain safe while stopped, and complete service after a native reconnection action within the frozen horizon
semantics.specialist: the existing healthy-inactive ShipAI package must be rerun on a byte-pinned water scenario and build at least one ship before G18
semantics.transfer: intermediate transfer may create feeder credit but not company cash; exactly one final-delivery payment accounts for all delivered cargo
